sources.title: EthioLLM: Multilingual Large Language Models - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: This paper introduces EthioLLM - multilingual large language models for five Ethiopian languages (Amharic, Ge'ez, Afan Oromo, Somali, and Tigrinya) and English, and Ethiobenchmark - a new benchmark dataset for various downstream NLP tasks. We evaluate the performance of these models across five downstream NLP tasks.
